newsitem.title: INDIA: India's auto stocks trade lower on Bombay bourse.
newsitem.headline: India's auto stocks trade lower on Bombay bourse.

text.p: Shares of Indian truckmaker TELCO and two-wheeler maker Bajaj Auto dropped sharply in late trade on Monday as punters hammered prices lower, traders said.
TELCO slid 15.50 rupees or 4.9 percent to 301 on the Bombay bourse while Bajaj slipped 36.50 rupees or 4.3 percent to 807.50.
Traders said punters and funds had been recent sellers in auto stocks on fears of a prolonged economic slowdown.
"Inventory pile ups, the economic slowdown - there's no new news on these two stocks. Cyclical stocks especially auto and cement are taking a beating," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
